title: 有馬記念の後に・昂揚

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond beats Kitasan Black and takes first place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A reporter asks about her future plans in the post-race interview, and Kitasan Black suggests that they face off again at the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond agrees, and the crowd is thrilled at the prospect of a rematch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After returning to her waiting room, Satono Diamond says Kitasan Black has already contributed to the Umamusume world by always getting the fans excited.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wonders what she ought to do as an illustrious runner, and explains that she wants to use Kitasan Black as an example to think about her own role.
